{ "source": "{% extends 'OT Layout' %} {% block content %} {% comment %} Portal landing page. Two jobs, in order. First a router to the areas open to the signed-in user; the personal counts and worklists stay on My Work (PP-03). Then the PP-17 outcome cards, which are reporting rather than routing: they count the whole book and drill into a filtered case list. Full MI and export remain back-office, in the Outcome Testing app. The shell-stage notice this page used to carry is gone. It said role-based navigation and assignment filtering were still to come; both landed with the Phase 2 security build (AD-047, AD-056, AD-069), so it was telling users the opposite of what the site now does. {% endcomment %}
  • Start here My Work
  • Search and open Cases
  • File quality Tax reviews
  • Advice quality AQS reviews
  • Actions and ageing Remediation
{% comment %} Outcome cards and their drill-down (PP-17, BR-005, BR-010, FR-032). A case's grade is on al_outcome, and BR-007 splits it across two columns so a regrade preserves the original. The grade in force is therefore final where one has been recorded, otherwise initial - the same precedence Outcomes.EffectiveOutcome applies server-side. In FetchXML that is an OR whose second branch is an AND, once per grade. Counted as distinct cases, not as outcome rows, because the card is answering "how many cases" and the drill-down lands on a list of cases. Both halves have to count the same thing or the number on the card will not match the number on the page it opens. Six small aggregates rather than one grouped query. A single query grouped by both outcome columns would be fewer round trips, but it would make the page depend on how an aliased choice column renders in Liquid - and a card that silently shows "120910711" instead of a grade is worse than a fifth aggregate. Every value below is a numeric literal from src/Entities/al_Outcome/Entity.xml; nothing here reads an option set back. Ungraded is total cases minus cases carrying an outcome row, taken as its own count rather than as "everything the four cards did not match". A case whose outcome row somehow held neither grade would otherwise be quietly added to Not yet graded, where nobody would look for it. {% endcomment %} {% fetchxml count_pass %} {% endfetchxml %} {% fetchxml count_issues %} {% endfetchxml %} {% fetchxml count_insufficient %} {% endfetchxml %} {% fetchxml count_harm %} {% endfetchxml %} {% fetchxml count_cases %} {% endfetchxml %} {% fetchxml count_graded %} {% endfetchxml %} {% comment %} An aggregate fetch returns no result set at all when the caller cannot read the table, and indexing entities[0] straight away then fails with "Index was outside the bounds of the array" - which renders as the card's number. The same guard My Work carries, for the same reason: a card must show a figure or nothing, never an error string. {% endcomment %} {% assign n_pass = 0 %} {% if count_pass.results and count_pass.results.entities.size > 0 %}{% assign n_pass = count_pass.results.entities[0].total %}{% endif %} {% assign n_issues = 0 %} {% if count_issues.results and count_issues.results.entities.size > 0 %}{% assign n_issues = count_issues.results.entities[0].total %}{% endif %} {% assign n_insufficient = 0 %} {% if count_insufficient.results and count_insufficient.results.entities.size > 0 %}{% assign n_insufficient = count_insufficient.results.entities[0].total %}{% endif %} {% assign n_harm = 0 %} {% if count_harm.results and count_harm.results.entities.size > 0 %}{% assign n_harm = count_harm.results.entities[0].total %}{% endif %} {% comment %} These two are subtracted rather than only displayed, so they are coerced first. `integer` is the same coercion the case list uses on its page parameter, and it is here for the same reason: `minus` on a value Liquid is holding as anything but a number does not fail loudly, it produces a wrong count. {% endcomment %} {% assign n_cases = 0 %} {% if count_cases.results and count_cases.results.entities.size > 0 %}{% assign n_cases = count_cases.results.entities[0].total | integer %}{% endif %} {% assign n_graded = 0 %} {% if count_graded.results and count_graded.results.entities.size > 0 %}{% assign n_graded = count_graded.results.entities[0].total | integer %}{% endif %} {% assign n_ungraded = n_cases | minus: n_graded %} {% if n_ungraded < 0 %}{% assign n_ungraded = 0 %}{% endif %}

Outcomes {{ n_cases }}

The grade each case currently stands on — its final outcome, or the initial one where no final grade has been recorded (BR-005, BR-007). Select a card to open the cases behind it. Full management information and the Trail Light export stay in the Outcome Testing app.

Outcome Testing

Tax and AQS checks, outcomes and remediation for Ascot Lloyd. Tax runs before AQS when a case requires both. Case import, allocation, question administration and reporting are handled by managers in the Outcome Testing app.

Which pages appear here depends entirely on the roles the portal resolves, and a person has no other way to find out what those are. Without this the only symptom of a role that has not taken effect is a menu item that is not there - which looks identical to a menu item that was never built, and is unreportable as anything more useful than "I cannot see the page". `user.roles` is the same list the access rules are evaluated against, so a role that is missing here was never reaching them. {% endcomment %} {% assign role_count = 0 %} {% for role in user.roles %}{% assign role_count = role_count | plus: 1 %}{% endfor %}
